utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — could you start by sorting the repair requests into what’s urgent and what can wait?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll sort the requests into urgent and can-wait first, then I’ll send you a quick list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the next thing that needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — could you double-check the drive list and tell me which parts are still missing?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll check the drive list now and let you know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies list for the repair drive. What do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — I think we still need a few more hands and maybe tape and a hammer? I might be forgetting something.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep the list updated and watch for tape and a hammer. If I spot anything else we’re short on, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d want to know the timing and where everything’s being dropped off first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense — I’ll check the timing and drop-off spot, then let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Nell — are we still on for the repair drive, and what time should I bring the tools?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mina — I’m still in, and I’ve heard we’re starting around 10. If you can bring the tools then, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll bring the tools at 10.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming along nicely—folks have been dropping off all sorts of things. If you want, I can tell you what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Tess—I'd love to hear what they still need. I can probably lend a hand or a tool or two.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, they’re still looking for a sturdy ladder, a few extension cords, and someone with a pickup to haul the bigger bits. If you’ve got any of that, it’d be a big help!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m already telling folks about the repair drive, and I can bring some extra flyers too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — could you leave the extra flyers by the community board? I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll leave the extra flyers by the community board this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re really in for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m in for the repair drive. Tell me what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure folks know where to bring their lists.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Rosa — I’ll spread the word and send people your way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Bo — I’ll be ready with the sign-up sheet and a clear drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for the repair drive, Eli—just tell me what I should bring and when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Vik—bring a pair of work gloves, a flashlight, and if you have one, a screwdriver set. Show up Saturday at 9 a.m. at the community shed, and I’ll have the list ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — work gloves, a flashlight, and a screwdriver set if I have one, and I’ll be there Saturday at 9 a.m. at the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m still a bit fuzzy on the details, but I can help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I can use a hand sorting donations and keeping track of what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I can sort donations and jot down what still needs fixing. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word and maybe pick up a few supplies if you’re out?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can spread the word and grab a few supplies when I’m out. Just send me the list, and I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, the repair drive is coming up soon—want me to put you on the invite list?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, please do — I’ll probably be a bit late, but I’d like to come by and help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll add you to the list and save you a spot. Just swing by whenever you can—late is totally fine.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. I’ve got a short list: sorting the tools, checking the donation box, and making sure the trailer is ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take the tools and the donation box. Want me to start with the trailer after that?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive—what time windows are we working with?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — the best windows are weekday evenings after 5:30 and Saturday morning before noon. I’ll check which one works best for the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me—I can help line up a Saturday morning slot if that’s easiest for the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive going—want me to help line up folks from both groups?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely—I can repeat the plan around and make sure folks from both groups hear it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, I’ll check in with the other side too and keep us all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Pia — I can lend a hand, and I’ve got a few tools if you need them. Just tell me what the repair drive needs next.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. I think we should check what’s missing first so we don’t end up hauling the wrong things.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good call — I’ll help make a quick list of what’s missing before we grab anything.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep track of the repair drive location and let you know the details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — that’s really helpful. Just let me know as soon as you have the location details, and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’m on it, and I’ll pass along the location as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive get a date yet, Hana?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet — I’m still checking the details before I say anything definite.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — can you tell me as soon as it’s confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive, Cleo. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — we could use screws, duct tape, and a couple of flashlights.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it — I’ll bring screws, duct tape, and a couple of flashlights.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive coming up—did I get that right? If so, I’d love the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think so—there’s a repair drive coming up soon. I’m a little fuzzy on the details, but I can find out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks—I’m happy to help once you know more.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Repair drive, huh? Just to confirm, what exactly are we fixing?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly the little stuff that’s been piling up — loose hinges, broken gadgets, squeaky doors, that kind of thing. Just whatever folks can bring in and we can patch up together.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so small repairs, not anything major? Just wanted to make sure I’m hearing that right.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll check in if I hear any news around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m a little scattered today, but I’m happy to help. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you bring your drill and a couple of extension cords? I’ll sort the checklist and meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I can do that — drill and a couple extension cords. I’ll grab them and head over.
